artikel.kurz: Finalizing Renewal 2026 & the Path Ahead
artikel.text:
Finalizing Renewal 2026 & the Path Ahead
November 2, 2026

Note: Full change logs can be found on our support site
Over the past four weeks, our entire community has engaged in a comprehensive gameplay evolution for Empires & Puzzles . Renewal 2026 was designed to address a few objectives, such as continuing to promote long-term tactical depth, enabling viable counterplay in every battle format, and curbing dependency on only a few family passives or 5 copies of any one Hero. More specifically, the aim was to bring diversity to the forefront in a way that celebrates synergy and distinctive Hero personality.
Following a month of live data, extensive testing, and direct community input, we are rolling out a new balance based on learnings from Renewal.
Rather than letting dominant families and supercharged passives narrow your choices to a handful of uniform team compositions, we have set a stable baseline where synergy, timing, and diversity clearly impact the outcome of every match.
Refining the Baseline: What Your Input Helped Shape
Throughout Renewal 2026, your gameplay and feedback drove real-time refinements to ensure these adjustments rewarded active strategy rather than completely blunting hero utility.
• Standardizing Combat Mechanics: Various game mechanics were recalibrated to regulate power variance between different effects, to function more consistently, and to make them more easily understood. Some of these changes went through multiple iterations during Renewal, based on player feedback, such as Ghost forms.

• Restoring player agency: This balance update shifts the power to decide battle outcomes back to players. Passive play and self-triggering effect loops are dialed back. The player choosing Heroes to counter abilities and making tactical moves during combat is king.

• Repositioning passive skills: Several powerful passive skills that had too great of a direct impact on battles were tuned down, but significant effort went into identifying opportunities to add situational utility and to remove unnecessary restrictions. For example, the Valiant Vegetables’ Blossom Mega Fiends have refocused on absorbing healing by having their HP boosted, and Rare and Epic Veggies got a double boost with harder-hitting Mega Fiends and the removal of the summon cap per turn.

These adjustments proved that high-stakes matches are won through deliberate team assembly, positioning, and board control.
Recalibration Supplies
We recognize that every Hero represents dedicated time, focus, and resources. Transitioning to this new state might require rediscovering how your Heroes contribute to your battle strategies. To encourage rotation of your top teams, the following recalibration supplies will be arriving in your accounts today and can be claimed from your in-game inbox:
• Aether Reset Tokens

• A library of Legendary Tomes

• Master Trainer Heroes

• XP Booster

• And more!

Take this time to test new combinations, reallocate your resources, and align your defense and attack teams!
Core Questions Answered
Will there be more balance changes of this scale in the immediate future? Renewal 2026 was a comprehensive recalibration that was far outside the purposes that our standard monthly balance updates normally serve. We always aim to proactively identify and remedy any features or mechanics that break out of their intended scope or begin to perform unexpectedly.

How does this change the value of future hero releases and existing rosters? Future hero designs will continue to expand strategic breadth and align with our goal of always making battles both fun and challenging. By keeping your focus on individual Heroes and less on family passive play, it allows for you to find synergies that you might have otherwise missed.
The Future of Adventure
Renewal 2026 has reset the stage for what Empires & Puzzles does best: tense, skill-driven tactical combat where sharp team synergy outplays brute force.
With the new general balance locked in, our full focus shifts forward with a multitude of exciting things like Season 6, which is already deep in development! This new season will bring both excitement and surprises. The end-of-year holiday season will also feature community challenges, giveaways, and exclusive in-game rewards! More on this to come but, to kick things off, let's check out what’s happening this week:
• 2 extra Aether Quests on Monday and Friday

• A week of Alliance Appreciation sharing offers

• 7 days of Gem Summon Challenges that unlock with only 5 Summons!

Collect your recalibration supplies from your inbox, test your new defensive setups, and take your place on the battlefield!

artikel.kurz: Renewal 2026 is here!
artikel.text:
Renewal 2026 is here!
October 6, 2026

‘ The winds of change are blowing. Harken, Heroes, and raise your swords! ’
Shake the dust from your boots and rally the troops as excitement, glory, and treasures await those brave enough to rise to the challenge!
We embark on a new journey with the launch of our Renewal 2026 event. This mighty event will offer new ways to use many of your favorite Heroes and shake up the battlefield! To kick it off, we have a message from the Small Giant Games development team, explaining Renewal 2026 in detail.

TL;DR For the duration of the Renewal 2026 event, changes that were made to a wide range of passive skills, status effects, and other mechanics will apply in all game modes. The aim is to increase player agency and to open up more battle strategies. Earn milestone rewards by completing battles.

Greetings Commanders,
For us at SGG, we truly believe that a great event is one that breaks you out of the norm. One where the gameplay feels fresh, tactics count as much as raw power, and you score nice rewards for your efforts! That is the essence of what this event is all about. So, let's get right into it.
To give you a better understanding of what Renewal 2026 is, let's first look at the event as a whole. R26 is a limited time event with rewards starting for players level 12, where we temporarily refresh core battle mechanics. This should result in some exciting opportunities to discover new synergies between Heroes! But, no event is complete without rewards, and that’s why we’ve added a series of milestone challenges that unlock Costume Keys, Epic Hero tokens, and even an event exclusive pin! We’re excited to see how these changes will play in the various PvP modes, so all your battles in Raids, Alliance Wars, and Raid Tournament will count toward earning your rewards.
Strategy has always been at the heart of what makes Empires & Puzzles fun. We spend a lot of time at the office debating the very best team configurations and how to use Heroes to get the most out of their abilities. One aim of this event is to provide players with a more active battle experience where the outcome of a fight isn't dependent on waiting for a passive to do all of the heavy lifting. With that in mind, Renewal 2026 will mix things up a bit and we’re confident that this new state of play will more than prove interesting.
We’ve seen a lot of feedback in recent times that combat is starting to feel stale. Skill effects, Hero passives, and Family bonuses will be at the forefront of changes that this event brings in order to reinvigorate battles. There will be clear changes during this event, with some effects being boosted and others being reined in. A great example of this is with Cheat Death, which will now reflect damage back to the attacker instead of to a random enemy. We have various objectives for Renewal, so let’s dive into a couple of them now.

‘Adjusted multiple passive effects that reduced player agency to now encourage more active battles’
To meet this goal we’ve fine-tuned aspects such as Thief’s Opportunity to now activate on an ally's Special Skill cast, instead of automatically with each turn. On top of that, we’ve also tuned Vengeful Haunting to be less oppressive by having attacks in Ghost form deal less damage and dispel only one buff from the target. Whereas before it would dispel all of them. Our logic here is that strategy and skill should give you the edge in battle and changes should respect the integrity of the Hero, not make them useless.
Over the past months, the Community team has gathered your thoughts for us on Discord through various polls and impromptu conversation starters. That’s also one reason why we’ve adjusted various effects that were too general in their functionality, so now they will have a more focused role. You’ll see this in action with the Veggies’ Seedling Summoner, Scoundrels’ Ambush, and even the Musketeers’ passive skill.

‘Several hard-to-avoid effects have been made easier to strategically counter’
We all know the frustration of having the perfect plan, only for some status effect to occur that you are completely at the mercy of because there’s hardly any way to counter it. That is why we have also changed all Ghost forms to being Stubborn instead of undispellable. Insanity is also getting some attention as it will now be affected by all healing instead of only some. On the flip side, a multitude of effects are now much more useful in battle like Wild effects and status effects that increase or decrease the damage dealt by Special Skills. En garde!
Lastly, let’s briefly talk about other changes that are coming with this event like realigning PvP rules for improved general balancing of attackers vs defenders. Renewal 2026 will push you to think outside the box. The standard boost for defense teams will be temporarily increased during this event. On top of that, we’ve also lowered critical chances to ensure a better balance during battles. Since we are on the subject, critical hits now also reduce max health in all game modes, not just PvP (this also works the same way for defense). To start wrapping this up, let's turn our attention to other changes that highlight the purpose of this special event…
‘Family’
You don’t need Dominic Toretto around to tell you how important family is in Empires & Puzzles. One example of progressive change that this event brings is that the Astral Demon family bonus will now function in the same way as the Beowulf family’s. It now cleanses a random ailment, instead of the most recent one received. Additionally, the cleanse part of the family bonus can now activate only once per turn, instead of indefinitely.
There’s much more to Renewal 2026, but we hope this has helped you to understand what we’re aiming for in this event. We will be monitoring your feedback and in game data very closely. It is our hope that you embrace the spirit of Renewal 2026, have fun with the new team combinations, and that battles keep you involved until the very last blow.

Join the conversation in our official Discord server and share your thoughts on Renewal 2026. You can find detailed notes on the event’s goals and the specific limited-time changes included here: Event Notes

artikel.kurz: Version 89 Release Notes & Status
artikel.text:
Version 89 Release Notes & Status
October 5, 2026



Status
Oct 5 , 2026 12:00 PM UTC: Update fully released.
Release Notes
[NEW & UPDATED CONTENT]

Halloween quest with monster lure
Our Halloween seasonal event returns with Sanguine Skull rare enemies who drop Spirit for free premium summons. This year, players can add a Monster Lure to double the spawn chance and the cap on rare enemies to farm even more free summons!

Rodent Heroes multiply in the Wilderness
The Adventurous Rodents sent their vanguard to our birthday celebrations in the Spring. Now, the rest of the family begins to emerge from the Wilderness with their Tiny Frames and Wild effects to Nibble your opponents.

New bonuses for older Heroes
This update brings 2 new bonuses to make leveling Heroes who have been in the game for several years or who have multiple costumes a lot faster! The Veteran Bonus increases XP gained and decreases Food/Iron costs when leveling Heroes released at least 3 years ago. The new Costume Collector bonus adds an XP increase that scales up with each additional Costume owned.

[IMPROVEMENTS & FIXES]
Improvements
• Path of Dragons will now appear in Dragonspire when the Return Pass is active in Stronghold

• Improved the Vengeful Ghost hit animations, making them more ghost-like

Fixes
• Fixed a minor visual issue where the “Impossible Completed!” text above the Ninja Tower icon would overlap with other UI elements on the Quests map

• Fixed an issue where C Fafnir’s damage increase stacks were incorrectly applied with a limited duration

• Fixed a minor visual issue where the background of the Raid arena banner would disappear when switching back to Raids view from Trophy Road

• Fixed an issue where Windfall Temple quest progress would sometimes not reset if a player had not been online since the previous Windfall Temple was still active

• Fixed an issue where an empty Event Results popup could appear if a player didn't return to the game within one week of the Windfall Temple event ending

• Fixed an issue in Windfall Temple where enemies would resist some transformation effects e.g. Cursed Painting

• Fixed an issue where enemies would sometimes not display correctly on the battlefield if they were defeated and revived in the same turn

• Fixed an issue with the animation for Kyrathis’ Special Skill where it would appear above one of the enemies nearby the target

• Fixed an issue where enemy name was not shown in Iron Arena raid battles

• Added info tooltips for Dragon rider stats in Dragonspire team edit

• Fixed an issue where Treasure Hoarder appearance chances would sometimes not be displayed in the Ancient Underroot quest

• Fixed an issue where Hero Team Power was not accurately reflecting all boosts from Spirit Bonus granted by an Assist Dragon

• Cassilda’s Special Skill now interacts with Taunt correctly

artikel.text:
August 2026 Balance Update II – Details & Release Notes
August 24, 2026



Note: This balance change is now live!
Full details of the changes are as follows:
Champion family
• Family bonus
• Defense buff added
• NEW: +20%/+30%/+40% defense (for 1/2/3 members)

• Attack buff adjusted
• OLD: +35%/+50%/+65% attack (for 1/2/3 members)

• NEW: +30%/+40%/+50% attack (for 1/2/3 members)

• Satori
• Passive Skills: Mana on Buff Dispel, Health Boost on Buff Dispel
• Now activate on each attempted dispel on the Hero with the Skill(s), not just when buffs are removed

Legends families
• Family bonuses
• Legends family bonuses are now granted for Heroes of the same element, instead of members of the same Legends family

• Legends family bonuses for 2+ Heroes no longer extend Element Links to allies of all elements

• Buffed various family bonus effects
• Legends 2018, 2023
• Defense boost increased: +10/15/20% -> +15/20/25% defense

• Legends 2019, 2022
• Attack boost increased: +10/15/20% -> +15/20/25% attack

• Legends 2020
• Heal buff increased: +10/15/20% -> +20/25/30% healing

• Legends 2021
• Critical chance buff increased: +10/15/20% -> +20/25/30% chance for critical hits

• Buffed various Element Links
• Aeron, Alasie, Gravemaker, Gregorion, Drake Fong
• +5% attack and +5% defense -> +15% attack and +15% defense

• Khiona, Aegir, Zimkitha, Evelyn, Onatel, Suzuna, Colt, Caravita
• 4% -> 5% health recovered each turn

• Kunchen, Frida, Anzogh, Margaret, Ranvir
• +46% -> +60% defense against the stronger element

• Seshat, Miki, Grazul, Kingston, Neith
• +4% -> +5% mana generation

• Grimble, Vela, Jean-François, Telluria, Malosi
• +10% -> +20% critical chance

• Clarissa, Raffaele, Noor, Zocc, Bai Yeong, Mystia, Eliane, Claeg, May, Akilius
• +30% -> +40% defense against Special Skills

• Zulag, Glenda, Reuben, Bertila, Uraeus
• Minion HP increased: 6% -> 7%

• Minion attack increased: 10% -> 12%

• Malicna, Frosth, Yang Mai, Elradir, Devana

Version 88 Release Notes & Status
August 18, 2026



Status
Aug 17, 2026 12:10 PM UTC: Android rollout started. We hope to do the same for iOS soon.
Release Notes
[NEW & UPDATED CONTENT]
Legends refresh
The Tavern of Legends reopens as a sports bar. Check out sporty costumes for Heroes of the Month, and more Champions. Earn more Summon Coins from stage rewards! Received a 5* Hero from the Legends Summon, but it wasn't quite what you were looking for? Use a free reroll to draw another 5* Hero, with guaranteed ascension levels!
Dragons vs Demons
Send your Dragons to defend a village under attack from winged demons, and reclaim valuable loot for the Heroes of your Stronghold
Quick Brawls
New 1-week Raid Brawl events with extra rules, and buffs for unique Heroes
Harvest Festival
As Fall rolls in, the Harpies rise! Meet a pair of Heroes from an all-new Family in our incredible Harvest Summon, where every summon guarantees 1-9 bonus draws.
Roster and auto-select filtering improvements
Hero roster now includes toggles to show Heroes that are currently trainable, ascendable, and limit breakable. New options for auto-select can be set based on element, max rarity, and family. Auto-select for Troops and Dragons can also be set by element and rarity.
[IMPROVEMENTS & FIXES]
Improvements
• Updated disclaimer text re: costumes in Max Power Preview

• New Raid matchmaking logic that takes trophy count and team power into account to provide a more balanced PvP experience for early game players

• The ability to refill energy directly from the resource bar has been extended to all types of energies, including Tower events, Temple quest, and Mythic Titan

• Improved UI for Welcome Back tasklist to indicate that all the tasks have been completed and all the gifts claimed

• Ambush status effects’ additional info text was adjusted to better match the functionality

• Added animation in Raids view when receiving trophies after a raid victory

• Updated additional info text on Astral Beam to state it is stronger against enemies with boosted health

• Platinum Shop UI/UX improvements. Tradable items amount in inventory visible inside the trade, added gift icon to Trader when free item unclaimed

• Windfall Temple event UI/UX improvements. Both Furor icons have been combined into one, and the Aura icon on hero portraits now shows remaining uses. Temple event screen now shows reward odds

• Secret bonus draw has been removed from the updated Legends Summon

Fixes
• Hero portraits should now function correctly in certain revival interactions, no more plain gray hero portraits!

• Fixed an issue where certain effects, like corrosive ailments, had their power adjusted unintentionally when the effect duration was increased.

• Fixed an issue with Alliance Featured Message sometimes cutting off

• Fixed an issue where claiming gems in exchange for unused Tokens of Appreciation would sometimes cause an error

• Status effects whose duration is reset by Special Skills now have the correct duration for attacking Heroes

• Fixed an issue where players would sometimes receive an empty raid history dialogue after an extended absence

• Fixed an issue where an event popup would sometimes unintentionally appear while the related quest is not visible to players
